title: Inter's best signing ever? Lautaro vs Zanetti — we picked
caption: Inter's best signing ever? Lautaro Martínez, 2018 from Racing: 181 goals, third on the club's all-time list, 9 trophies, the captain. Javier Zanetti, 1995 from Banfield: 858 games and 16 trophies, both club records. Ronaldo, Sneijder, Milito and Thuram are in the lineup too. We picked.
